acceptable_paraphrases: an octagon has 8 lines of symmetry
the figure is an octagon with 8 lines of symmetry
it's an octagon and it has 8 lines of symmetry
the shape in question is an octagon with 8 symmetrical lines
critical_errors: incorrect number of lines of symmetry (not 8)
identifying the figure as something other than an octagon
misconceptions: believing that all polygons have a fixed number of lines of symmetry
mistaking the shape for another polygon with fewer or more sides
mentioning incorrect number of lines of symmetry other than 8
grading_notes: Ensure the answer includes both the correct numerical value and description of the figure. Look out for students who might confuse this octagon with a square or a triangle.
